Alibaba built a 2.4 trillion parameter AI that only uses about 3% of it at a time. Qwen4-Max switches on 71 billion parameters at once, 25% fewer than the last version, so it's cheaper to run. In Alibaba's own factory demo, a 475 minute programming job took 24 minutes, and Alibaba says tasks cost about 60% less. The catch: on the Artificial Analysis index it still sits 3 points behind Kimi K3.1 Pro. Sources: Alibaba (via HPCwire), SCMP, Wccftech, Nov 16, 2026.
